Independent companion to Justin Bennington, Somewhere Systems, Working paper v1, 17 October 2026. 11 PDF pages, printed=PDF. Research credit belongs to Bennington.

Rights and checks: ATTRIBUTION.md, LICENSE, VERIFICATION.md.

Keep proposed taxonomy, author classifications, reported simulation and guide interpretation separate. No hsf execution, raw-data audit, preregistration verification or independent 22-system recoding occurred. H1/H6 hold; H2–H5 mixed. Command != communication != governance != lifecycle. Preserve three figure-reference errors and reported numerical precision. Do not assert real-world robustness from simulated results.
